column1: # corpus-census-swift.tsv — the PINNED swift chained-corpus roster (swift L0, 2026-11-25).
# WHY.  The chained swift corpora behind R1455 / R1865 / R1866 were copies under the session scratchpad
# (/private/tmp/.../scratchpad/swiftagent-*/ab/corpus) and were found HOLLOW: every directory present, 0 regular files
# (`bin/corpus.sh --hollow-check` says HOLLOW: ".git is present but HEAD does not resolve"), the shape R242 describes.
# The macOS /private/tmp cleaner and the per-user /var/folders dirhelper both reclaim files and leave directories.
# WHERE IT LIVES NOW.  ~/.candor/corpus/swift-chained  (the corpus home `bin/corpus.sh` documents: under $HOME, never
# auto-reclaimed, only `bin/disk-guard.sh` stands between it and a full disk; 387 MB).  It survives a reboot because it is
# not under /tmp, /private/tmp or $TMPDIR.  Rebuild it with:
# The 39 entries are the `tracka-r1/swift-t4/corpus` set (~/candor-handoff/tracka-r1/swift-t4/, itself rebuilt 2026-11-07
# from the swiftab-a/b handoff copies after an earlier cleaner pass); `entries.txt` there is the roster.
# LIVE, NOT JUST PRESENT.  mkpool.sh symlinks each entry's TRANSITIVE in-pool dependency closure into
# <entry>/.build/checkouts, so candor-swift can map module -> package and a CANDOR_DEPS chain actually JOINS (SOUNDNESS R700:
# without it the chained arm is byte-identical to the standalone one).  Liveness is then asserted BY COUNT:
# name <TAB> HEAD sha (git -C <entry> rev-parse HEAD) <TAB> swift files <TAB> in-pool dependency closure size <TAB> clone origin when it was made
# (a file:///…/swiftpm/repositories origin is a SwiftPM cache clone; the sha is the pin, the origin is not.)
